recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce a coded ImagingStudy procedure binding for FHIR-15109; if a future work-group decision adds coded performed procedures back to ImagingStudy, use the later FHIR-20166 and FHIR-32793 history as guidance for a canonical LOINC/RSNA Playbook value set with preferred binding strength.
issue_request: FHIR-15109 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Imaging Integration change request asking that the old ImagingStudy.procedureCode binding not use SNOMED CT/generic procedure-code content and instead point implementers toward radiology procedure code guidance from RadLex/LOINC-RSNA Playbook.
initial_application: Git commit 7b2b64512052c9a800a59b0ac3cd2cd013659b1b, whose subject includes GF#15109, applied the issue to the then-active ImagingStudy spreadsheet by changing ImagingProcedureCode from http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/procedure-code to http://www.rsna.org/RadLex_Playbook.aspx and describing RadLex as preferred.
additional_context: Later final ImagingStudy procedure issues changed the same source surface: FHIR-20166 corrected the obsolete RadLex URL toward the LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook value set, FHIR-19637 merged procedureCode and procedureReference into a repeated procedure element, FHIR-32719 converted the R5 shape to CodeableReference, FHIR-32793 weakened the coded binding to preferred, and later R6 work ended with current ImagingStudy.procedure as Reference(Procedure). The combined branch already contains reconciliation commits for those later related issues.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini actively includes ImagingStudy and records ImagingStudy.procedureCode as renamed to ImagingStudy.procedure, while source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml defines the current procedure element as 0..* Reference(Procedure) with no terminology binding. The only remaining obsolete RadLex URL found is in a generated-looking copied SVG under source/genomicstudy, and GenomicStudy is not active in source/fhir.ini.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the same ImagingProcedureCode binding URL from the obsolete RSNA page to the LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook value set.
Merged the old procedureCode/procedureReference elements into a repeated procedure element, explaining why procedureCode is no longer active source.
Converted the R5 procedure backbone/value[x] shape to CodeableReference before later R6 modeling changes.
Weakened the same coded procedure binding from extensible to preferred before the coded binding surface was removed.
Current R6 decision restored ImagingStudy.procedure as the performed Procedure reference, superseding the old coded binding shape.
